old text: The 50mm Granatwerfer 36 was a light mortar used by Germany during World War II. It was intended to be used against targets which were beyond a hand grenade's throwing range but the weapon ended to be too complex and had neither enough range nor sufficient explosive payload.

old text: A squad of 12 elite jaegers, skill 8. The main purpose of the German Jaeger Divisions was to fight in adverse terrain where smaller, coordinated units were more facilely combat capable than the brute force offered by the standard infantry divisions. The Jaegers (means hunters in German) relied on a high degree of training, and slightly superior communications. They were among the prioritized to get new weapons such as the StG44 and G43. This elite jaeger squad includes an MG42 team, a sniper, and a rifle-grenadier, allowing for wide scale operation adaptability.
new text: Elite Jaeger squad of 10, skill 8, with an MG34 team, a G43 sniper, a rifle-grenadier, StG44s and Panzerfausts. Trained for adverse terrain, it adapts to a wide range of tasks.

old text: A squad of 12 apex paratroopers, skill 10. Battle-scarred Fallschirmjaegers who had undergone many battles and survived since the Battle of Crete, they were among the best men the Fatherland can offer. Includes a sniper, two MG42 teams, 2 FG42s, and 3 rifle-grenadiers.
new text: Apex Fallschirmjaeger squad of 10 battle-scarred veterans, skill 10, with a sniper, two MG42 teams, 2 FG42s and rifle-grenadiers. Among the best men the Fatherland can offer.

old text: This team of specialists comes equipped with a flamethrower which strikes terror into the hearts of the enemy. However, the fuel canister each troop carries on his back is highly volatile and could lead to sudden and certain death if hit by enemy fire. Use these specialists wisely, as you only have few available for each battle.

new text: Battle hardened Elite SS Panzergrenadier 'LSSAH' squad of 11 with 2 MG34s, 5 K98 rifles, 1 K98 sniper rifle, 2 G41s and 1 MP40. Soldiers are skill 7.

new text: Bulgarian line infantry squad of 8 men armed mostly with bolt-action rifles. Reliable for holding ground and steady advances, best with machine-gun or mortar support.

old text: Hungarian close-quarters squad mixing Danuvia 39M and captured PPSh-41 SMGs. Built for assaults in streets and trenches
new text: Hungarian close-quarters squad of 9 men mixing Danuvia 39M and captured PPSh-41 SMGs. Built for assaults in streets and trenches.

new text: Italian Alpini mountain troops, 13 men with rifles, SMGs, a Breda LMG team and a marksman. Effective in rough terrain; the marksman has solid stamina for climbs and relocations.

old text: Veteran single tank crewman for rapid re-crewing of vehicles or guns. Limited personal firepower. Slightly slower on foot than line infantry.
new text: Single veteran tank crewman for rapid re-crewing of vehicles or guns. Limited personal firepower and slightly slower on foot than line infantry.

old text: Romanian mine-disposal pair trained to detect and clear enemy minefields. Can dig trenches. Vulnerable while working.
new text: Romanian mine-disposal pair trained to detect and clear enemy minefields, and able to dig trenches. Vulnerable while working.

old text: Single Italian rifleman with Carcano - picket duty and point defense.
new text: Single Italian rifleman with a Carcano for picket duty and point defense.

old text: Single Romanian rifleman with ZB-24 - screening and security.
new text: Single Romanian rifleman with a ZB-24 for screening and security.

old text: Single Romanian Orita SMG gunner - close-quarters point defense.
new text: Single Romanian SMG gunner with an Orita for close-quarters point defense.

old text: Single Finnish Suomi KP/-31 gunner - excellent CQB volume of fire; ideal for room entry and trench clearing.
new text: Single Finnish SMG gunner with a Suomi KP/-31 and a high volume of close-range fire. Ideal for room entry and trench clearing.

old text: Single Hungarian Danuvia SMG gunner - fast, compact CQB support.
new text: Single Hungarian SMG gunner with a Danuvia for fast, compact close-quarters support.

new text: Bulgarian team of 4 sappers that lays anti-personnel mines and wire. Its minefields deny routes and fix enemy infantry before assaults.

new text: Bulgarian team of 4 sappers with anti-tank mines and hedgehogs. Its obstacles canalize armor into AT kill zones.

old text: Two-man Hungarian light MG team (Solothurn 31M). Provides mobile suppressive fire to pin enemies and cover maneuvers.
new text: Hungarian 2-man light MG team with a Solothurn 31M. Provides mobile suppressive fire to pin enemies and cover maneuvers.

old text: Two-man Bulgarian ZB vz. 26 LMG team - compact base-of-fire element for bunker entry support and hasty assaults.
new text: Bulgarian 2-man ZB vz. 26 LMG team, a compact base of fire for supporting bunker entries and hasty assaults.

old text: Two-man Alpini Breda 30 LMG team - steady suppressive fire for clearing small positions.
new text: Alpini 2-man Breda 30 LMG team giving steady suppressive fire for clearing small positions.

old text: Two-man Bersaglieri Breda 30 LMG team - mobile suppressive fire to force movement from cover.
new text: Bersaglieri 2-man Breda 30 LMG team giving mobile suppressive fire that forces enemies to move from cover.

old text: Two-man paratrooper Breda 30 LMG team - airborne base-of-fire; coordinate with rifle elements for obscuration.

old text: Finnish two-man Boys anti-tank rifle team - effective vs. light armor and soft-skins; finish disabled vehicles or clear exposed crews.
new text: Finnish 2-man Boys anti-tank rifle team, effective against light armor and soft-skins. Good for finishing disabled vehicles or clearing exposed crews.

old text: Bulgarian two-man anti-tank rifle team (PzB) - ambush light vehicles and harass transports; close to finish when crews are exposed.
new text: Bulgarian 2-man PzB anti-tank rifle team for ambushing light vehicles and harassing transports. It closes in to finish vehicles once their crews are exposed.

old text: Two Hungarian Panzerfaust operators - disposable close-range anti-armor punch; use cover and angles to approach armor. Assault elements demonstrate strong stamina for closing to range.
new text: Hungarian pair of Panzerfaust operators with a disposable close-range anti-armor punch and strong stamina for closing to range. They need cover and good angles to approach armor.

old text: Romanian two-man Panzerschreck team - high-lethality AT rockets; avoid exposure during reloads.
new text: Romanian 2-man Panzerschreck team firing high-lethality AT rockets. Vulnerable when exposed during reloads.

old text: Finnish flamethrower team with escort - terrifying at point-blank range for bunker and room clearing; avoid exposing the flamer to direct fire.
new text: Finnish flamethrower team of 2, a flamer with a rifle escort, terrifying at point-blank range for clearing bunkers and rooms. The flamer must be kept out of direct fire.

old text: Finnish marksman - precision elimination and spotting; relocate frequently. Good stamina aids frequent repositioning.
new text: Finnish marksman for precision kills and spotting. Good stamina helps the frequent relocations he needs.

old text: Finnish field officer - improves spotting and coordination across nearby units; keep out of direct combat.
new text: Finnish field officer who improves spotting and coordination for nearby units. Best kept out of direct combat.

old text: AS.42 Sahariana patrol truck mounting a 47mm. Fast desert-born raider - excellent mobility and harassment; avoid direct duels with armor.
new text: AS.42 Sahariana patrol truck with a 47mm gun, a fast raider with excellent mobility for harassment. It should avoid direct duels with armor.

old text: Fiat 626 transport for infantry logistics and redeployments. Unarmed and vulnerable - keep off the line of fire.
new text: Fiat 626 unarmed transport for infantry logistics and redeployments. Vulnerable, so it should stay out of the line of fire.

old text: Fiat 626 artillery hauler for heavy munitions and crews. Unarmed; use behind cover and routes out of observation.
new text: Fiat 626 unarmed artillery hauler for heavy munitions and crews. Best used behind cover and on routes out of enemy observation.

old text: 38/42M Botond light truck - quick troop and ammo mover. Ideal for fast flanks and point captures; fragile under fire.
new text: 38/42M Botond light truck that quickly moves troops and ammo for fast flanks and point captures. Fragile under fire.

old text: Infantry ammo crate - resupplies small arms and light/medium mortars (Brixia 45mm, 81mm), including HE/smoke/WP/illum bombs. Site under cover near infantry positions.
new text: Infantry ammo crate that resupplies small arms and the Brixia 45mm and 81mm mortars, including HE, smoke, WP and illum bombs. Best sited under cover near infantry positions.

old text: Heavy ammo crate (Artillery) - resupplies cannons, autocannons and heavy mortars (120mm), including HE/smoke/WP/illum bombs; also feeds AT/AA/tank guns (e.g., 75mm Resita, 40mm Nimród). Keep rearward and concealed.
new text: Heavy artillery ammo crate that resupplies cannons, autocannons, AT, AA and tank guns (e.g. 75mm Resita, 40mm Nimród) and 120mm mortars with HE, smoke, WP and illum bombs. Keep it rearward and concealed.

old text: Special ammo crate - resupplies special cannon rounds on eligible vehicle/towed guns (e.g., HEAT/APCR/WP). Does not refill mortar bombs - use Infantry/Artillery crates for mortars.
new text: Special ammo crate that resupplies special cannon rounds such as HEAT, APCR and WP for eligible vehicle and towed guns. It does not refill mortar bombs, which need the Infantry or Artillery crates.

old text: Breda M31 HMG on mount - sustained anti-infantry fire and light vehicle harassment. Requires cover and ammo support.
new text: Breda M31 HMG on a mount for sustained anti-infantry fire and harassing light vehicles. It needs cover and ammo support.

old text: 37mm Bofors AA/AT - high rate AA and useful vs light armor. Site with fields of fire; reposition to avoid counter-battery.
new text: 37mm Bofors AA/AT gun with a high rate of AA fire that is also useful against light armor. It needs good fields of fire and should reposition to avoid counter-battery fire.

old text: Semovente da 149/40 - mobile heavy gun for long-range HE. Devastates fortifications; keep distance and spot with scouts.
new text: Semovente da 149/40 mobile heavy gun firing long-range HE that devastates fortifications. It should keep its distance and rely on scouts for spotting.

old text: Fiat Dovunque M35 with 20mm - mobile AA/AI mount. Rapid response to low flyers and soft targets; avoid tank duels.
new text: Fiat Dovunque M35 with a 20mm gun, a mobile AA and anti-infantry mount for rapid response to low flyers and soft targets. It should avoid tank duels.

old text: 40M Csaba armored car - fast scout with autocannon/ MG. Ideal for reconnaissance, flanks and light skirmishing.
new text: 40M Csaba armored car, a fast scout with an autocannon and MG. Ideal for reconnaissance, flanks and light skirmishing.

old text: 39M Csaba armored car - early variant scout with MG/autocannon. Use speed and terrain to probe and harass.
new text: 39M Csaba armored car, an early scout variant with an MG and autocannon. It uses speed and terrain to probe and harass.

old text: Lancia 1ZM - early armored car with twin MGs. Suited for patrols and point security; vulnerable to AT fire.
new text: Lancia 1ZM early armored car with twin MGs, suited for patrols and point security. Vulnerable to AT fire.

old text: AMD-35 Panhard - speedy recon car with 25mm. Effective vs infantry and light armor; avoid heavier AFVs.
new text: AMD-35 Panhard fast recon car with a 25mm gun, effective against infantry and light armor. It should avoid heavier AFVs.

old text: Autoblindo AB41 - balanced scout with 20mm. Good road speed and flexibility; best in reconnaissance and screening roles.
new text: Autoblindo AB41 balanced scout car with a 20mm gun, good road speed and flexibility. Best in reconnaissance and screening roles.

old text: Semovente M15/42 Contraereo - self-propelled AA with dual mounts. Strong anti-air and AI volume; keep moving to survive.
new text: Semovente M15/42 Contraereo self-propelled AA gun with dual mounts and strong anti-air and anti-infantry fire. It must keep moving to survive.

new text: 40M Nimród SPAA with a potent 40mm gun, excellent against planes and able to act as a light TD against soft skins. It should avoid medium tanks head-on.

old text: L35 Lanciafiamme - flamethrower tankette for point-blank assaults. Devastating in urban/trench fighting; extremely fragile.
new text: L35 Lanciafiamme flamethrower tankette for point-blank assaults, devastating in urban and trench fighting. Extremely fragile.

old text: BT-42 assault gun - howitzer on BT chassis. Heavy HE for bunker busting; very vulnerable to AT - strike and reposition.
new text: BT-42 assault gun with a howitzer on a BT chassis, firing heavy HE for bunker busting. Very vulnerable to AT fire, so it should strike and reposition.

old text: The effectiveness of a tank depends, first of all, on a crew's cohesion and its ability to act consistently in any situation. The most powerful and dangerous vehicle will become a pile of scrap metal if there's no crew to control it. When training a tank crew, interchangeability of all members is the key, because the tank must remain combat-ready, even if only one crew member survives. \n Although Hungarian tank crews are armed with government-issue weapons, they have no combat training and hence are extremely vulnerable.
new text: Hungarian tank crews are trained so any member can keep a tank fighting, even if only one survives. They carry government-issue weapons but lack combat training and are very vulnerable.

new text: The home guard is an untrained civilian with a standard-issue FEG 35M rifle, best at long and medium range. Up close he is easy prey for submachine gunners and assault infantry.

old text: A soldier armed with a flame-thrower can inflict heavy damage on infantry inside a building and can single-handedly clear an entire area of enemies. Accordingly, a combat unit includes several escort submachine gunners.
new text: The flamethrower soldier can clear buildings and whole areas alone, but is unarmed once his fuel runs out and his cylinder can explode if hit. Escort submachine gunners go with him.

old text: The Riflegrenade Men is our glorious answer to enemy support. By utilizing a 50mm at-grenade, it can easily kill unarmored targets and infantry at range. This ability allows our infantry to deliver supporting anti-infatry fire anywhere on the battlefield and shall prove invaluable. However, it requires a strong, skillful soldier to effectively handle this weapon, so utilize these men carefully.

old text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman, capable of calling in precise artillery strikes with his signal flares. A trained artillery observer awaits in the rear, ready at a moments' notice to direct fire down onto any signals he sees. The Radio Operator's unique abilities make him valuable, and special care should be taken to keep him from harm.
new text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman who calls in precise artillery strikes with signal flares. He is valuable, so take special care to keep him from harm.

old text: The effectiveness of a tank depends, first of all, on a crew's cohesion and its ability to act consistently in any situation. The most powerful and dangerous vehicle will become a pile of scrap metal if there's no crew to control it. When training a tank crew, interchangeability of all members is the key, because the tank must remain combat-ready, even if only one crew member survives. \n Although Hungarian tank crews are armed with government-issue weapons, they have no combat training and hence are extremely vulnerable.
new text: Hungarian tank crews are trained so any member can keep a tank fighting, even if only one survives. They carry government-issue weapons but lack combat training and are very vulnerable.

old text: This anti-tank infantrymen is equipped with an anti-tank rifle, perfectly suited for taking out lightly armored enemy vehicles. While the high velocity rifle packs a punch, it is insufficient to take on heavier vehicles and it may require several shots to fully disable light vehicles.
new text: The anti-tank infantryman's high-velocity anti-tank rifle suits lightly armored vehicles. It cannot take on heavier vehicles and may need several shots to disable light ones.

old text: This squad of renowned paratroopers is equipped with an excellent selection of automatic rifles, regular rifles and light machine guns. These soldiers display the utmost devotion and pride, and they come prepared to fight and die for their country, without hesitation.
new text: The renowned paratroopers carry an excellent mix of automatic rifles, regular rifles and light machine guns. Devoted and proud, they fight for their country without hesitation.

old text: This team of specialists arrives with a full complement of anti-personnel mines which can be placed to provide the perfect defense against advancing infantry. Deploy them along likely routes of enemy advance or use them to secure a vulnerable flank from enemy attack.
new text: The specialist team carries a full complement of anti-personnel mines against advancing infantry. Lay them along likely enemy routes or use them to secure a vulnerable flank.

old text: This team of specialists arrives with a full complement of anti-tank mines which can be deployed to thwart advances made by enemy vehicles. Place them along roads or other likely routes of enemy advance. In some cases, a mine might only disable a vehicle, so be prepared to finish off any enemy vehicles which get disabled by your mines.
new text: The specialist team carries a full complement of anti-tank mines to stop enemy vehicles on roads and likely routes. A mine may only disable a vehicle, so be ready to finish it off.

old text: This team of specialists is equipped with mine detectors and is trained in mine disposal. They are the most effective way of clearing enemy minefields. Once mines have been detected, they can be re-deployed for use against their former owners. However, these soldiers are vulnerable whilst searching for mines, so take measures to protect them.
new text: The sapper team uses mine detectors to clear enemy minefields and can re-lay the mines against their former owners. They are vulnerable while searching, so protect them.

old text: This pair of tank crews are only lightly armed but are well-suited for crewing your armored vehicles and field guns. Use them to replace the losses you have suffered in combat and re-man your equipment. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.
new text: The pair of tank crews is lightly armed but well suited to crewing armored vehicles and field guns after losses. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.

old text: This pair of support crew are only lightly armed but are well-suited for crewing your armored vehicles and field guns. Use them to replace the losses you have suffered in combat and re-man your equipment. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.
new text: The pair of support crew is lightly armed but well suited to crewing armored vehicles and field guns after losses. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.

new text: The veteran pair of support crew is lightly armed but well suited to crewing armored vehicles and field guns after losses. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.

old text: French troops were nowhere given as many Bazookas as American troops. This sapper squad is equipped with entrenching tools, satchel charges, and a bazooka to breach enemy fortifications.
new text: The French sapper squad carries entrenching tools, satchel charges and a bazooka to breach enemy fortifications. French troops got far fewer Bazookas than American troops.

new text: The pair of tank crews is lightly armed but well suited to crewing armored vehicles and field guns after losses. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.

old text: This pair of tank crews are only lightly armed but are well-suited for crewing your armored vehicles and field guns. Use them to replace the losses you have suffered in combat and re-man your equipment. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points. They are the best of the Free French, so use them wisely!
new text: The pair of tank crews, the best of the Free French, is lightly armed but well suited to crewing vehicles and field guns. They are not suited for infantry combat and can't capture points.

old text: The Black Prince is based on the Churchill chassis but has had its armament improved with the inclusion of the deadly 17pdr gun. With its superior armor, and boasting one of the best guns of the war, the Black Prince is perfectly suited to tackle enemy armor and is built to match all but the very best the enemy has to offer. Use it to engage and destroy armor, and to drive your enemy from the field of battle before your tea gets cold!
new text: The Black Prince is a Churchill-based tank with superior armor and the deadly 17pdr gun, a match for all but the enemy's very best. Use it to destroy enemy armor.

old text: The Spetsnaz is one of our toughest soldiers, trained for months under the very harshest conditions our Motherland can provide. Equipped with all possible means of destruction, this soldier is best used behind the occupiers front lines, where he can inflict massive damage to the unsuspecting enemy. Keep low and go slow -- use his additional stealth carefully and he will pay for himself many times over.
new text: The Spetsnaz is a tough soldier with every means of destruction, best used behind enemy lines. Keep low and go slow, and his extra stealth will repay his cost many times.

old text: The Guards Riflemen are honourable comrades who have proven themselves many times on the battlefield! Armed with light machine guns and anti-tank rifles, they have the power to stop infantry and light armor alike. This combination makes them a team well suited to deal with a range of threats, so use them wisely!
new text: The Guards Riflemen carry light machine guns and anti-tank rifles that can stop infantry and light armor alike. This makes them a team well suited to a range of threats.

old text: The Black Coats, also known as the Black Deaths to our enemies! The cream of our marines, these soldiers are armed to the teeth and will stop at nothing to serve their country. Arriving in a half-track, they possess the speed and mobility to make them the optimal spearhead of your troops. Push back the enemy and reclaim our territory for Mother Russia!
new text: The Black Coats are the cream of the marines, armed to the teeth. They arrive in a half-track, with the speed and mobility to spearhead your troops.

old text: The Radio Operator is a special trained infantryman capable of calling in precise artillery strikes with his signal flares. A trained artillery observer awaits in the rear, ready at a moments' notice to direct fire down onto any signals he sees. The Radio Operator's unique abilities make him valuable, and special care should be taken to keep him from harm.
new text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman who calls in precise artillery strikes with signal flares. He is valuable, so take special care to keep him from harm.

old text: The KV-2 heavy assault tanks are named after our comrade, Commissar Kliment Voroshilov, and each one is sponsored by a Russian village. While it is well-armored, it is the force of arms this vehicle possesses that teaches our enemies to quake at its approach: equipped with a 152mm howitzer, this tank can destroy anything but the heaviest of enemy targets. Once the KV-2 rolls onto the battlefield, retreat will be our enemies' only option!
new text: The KV-2 is a well-armored heavy assault tank whose 152mm howitzer can destroy all but the heaviest enemy targets.

old text: The Shock Infantry resemble some of the toughest soldiers offered by the Soviet Union. Shock infantry carry body armor and wield flamethrowers allowing them to assault even the toughest defensive positions. Known for their bravery and zeal these troops will help push any frontline forward.
new text: The Shock Infantry are tough Soviet soldiers with body armor and flamethrowers who can assault even the toughest defensive positions and push any frontline forward.

old text: The BM-8-24 is a variant of the Katyusha rocket system adapted on the T-60 chassis. The lighter 82mm BM-8 rockets are not as devestating as their heavier cousin, but offer commanders impressive fire support with their unmatched fire rate and capability to destroy the last bit of enemy morale left!
new text: The BM-8-24 is a Katyusha rocket system on the T-60 chassis. Its lighter 82mm rockets hit less hard, but their unmatched fire rate gives impressive fire support.

old text: The U.S. Marines are some of the finest soldiers available. They are well-equipped with both submachine and light machine guns, ready for close combat. Their tenacious reputation in battle proves them to be the very embodiment of their motto: 'Semper Fi' -- 'always faithful'. They never waver in their unflinching defense of freedom against all foes, no matter what the odds!
new text: The U.S. Marines are among the finest soldiers available, well equipped with submachine and light machine guns for close combat. True to their motto 'Semper Fi', they never waver.

old text: The 101st Airborne are well-trained and highly skilled paratroopers. With dedication and bravery surpassing most other troops, they will stop at nothing to accomplish the task at hand. Arriving in a half-track, they possess the speed and mobility that earns them the capacity to be the spearhead of your troops. They've established a well-deserved reputation from their performance in numerous previous battles, and now they are called upon to once again uphold their reputation and fight for their country!
new text: The 101st Airborne are well-trained, highly skilled paratroopers who arrive in a half-track, with the speed and mobility to spearhead your troops.

old text: The Radio Operator is a special trained infantryman capable of calling in precise artillery strikes with his signal flares. A trained artillery observer awaits in the rear, ready at a moments' notice to direct fire down onto any signals he sees. The Radio Operator's unique abilities make him valuable, and special care should be taken to keep him from harm.
new text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman who calls in precise artillery strikes with signal flares. He is valuable, so take special care to keep him from harm.

old text: The M4A3(105) is based on the chassis of our regular M4A3 Sherman, but comes fitted with a short-barrelled 105mm howitzer. It is capable of destroying fortified targets and softening enemy defenses from distances that greatly exceed that of than any conventional tank cannon. It is an excellent weapon for supporting our troops and can quickly reposition itself to address any new threats that might appear on the battlefield. Use it carefully and it will serve you well.
new text: The M4A3(105) is an M4A3 Sherman with a short-barrelled 105mm howitzer that destroys fortified targets from beyond tank gun range. It supports troops well and repositions quickly.

old text: The .30 cal Browning A6 is a light machine gun designed to be carried and operated by a single infantryman. The M1919 A6 is a significant upgrade to the BAR and vastly improves the fire support of our GIs. One step closer to liberate the world from our enemies!
new text: The .30 cal Browning M1919 A6 is a light machine gun carried and operated by one infantryman. It is a big upgrade over the BAR and greatly improves your GIs' fire support.

old text: The US Combat Engineers perform a variety of construction tasks, but are specifically trained to destroy obstacles and heavy emplacements. Armed with satchel charges, usually a messanger bag filled with C-4 and a triggering mechanism, these troops often create awe-inspiring explosions exposing enemy lines.
new text: The US Combat Engineers are trained to destroy obstacles and heavy emplacements with satchel charges, often blowing open enemy lines.

old text: The Devil's Brigade is an elite, joint commando unit organized by the Americans and Canadians. This unit is designed to conduct special operations behind enemy lines including eliminating specific targets, interrupting communications and raiding supply routes. These men are limited in number, but their stealth and destructive power are unmatched.
new text: The Devil's Brigade is an elite American-Canadian commando unit that raids targets, communications and supply routes behind enemy lines, with unmatched stealth and power.

old text: Finnish Sissi special detachment with SMGs, rifles and an LMG team. Suited for reconnaissance, quick strikes and close-to-mid-range fights; vision-trained elements aid spotting.
new text: Finnish Sissi detachment of 9 men with SMGs, rifles and an LMG team, trained for spotting. Suited for reconnaissance, quick strikes and close-to-mid-range fights.

old text: Legendary Finnish sniper armed with a scoped Mosin-Nagant. Exceptional marksmanship and concealment for precision eliminations at long range. Notably high stamina enables frequent repositioning.
new text: Legendary Finnish sniper with a scoped Mosin-Nagant, exceptional marksmanship and concealment for precise long-range kills. High stamina lets him reposition often.

old text: Elite Romanian gun detachment - 75mm Resita with elite support crew. Strong static anti-armor and area denial; keep the piece protected while it works.
new text: Elite Romanian 75mm Resita gun with elite support crew and a 4-man Bersaglieri escort with an LMG. Strong static anti-armor and area denial; keep the gun protected.

old text: Aggressive scouting package - includes 39M Csaba and 40M Csaba armored cars with veteran crews. Harass infantry and light vehicles; avoid drawn-out fights with heavier armor.
new text: Aggressive scouting group of two 39M Csaba and one 40M Csaba armored cars with crews. Harasses infantry and light vehicles; avoid drawn-out fights with heavier armor.

old text: Hungarian mobile group - includes Turán III, Botond transport, tank crew, and assault infantry (riflemen, Panzerfaust operators, SMG/LMG team). Use speed and armor to break lines and seize ground. Assault elements exhibit notably high stamina.
new text: Hungarian mobile group of two Turán III tanks and two Botond transports with crews, plus 20 assault infantry with rifles, Panzerfausts and LMGs. Uses speed and armor to break lines.

old text: Static defense package - includes 75mm Resita AT gun, Breda-Safat AA mount, 120mm mortar, and support crew. Anchors a sector against vehicles and infantry - site carefully and protect from raids.
new text: Static defense group of two 75mm Resita AT guns, two Breda-Safat AA mounts, a 120mm mortar and 10 crew. Anchors a sector against vehicles and infantry; guard it from raids.

old text: Veteran Italian M9053 tank destroyer with elite crew. Long-range anti-armor platform - ambush from cover and relocate to avoid counter-fire.
new text: Italian M9053 tank destroyer with a 4-man veteran crew. Long-range anti-armor platform; ambush from cover and relocate to avoid counter-fire.

old text: Thor and Morser Karl, was a World War II German self-propelled siege mortar designed and built by Rheinmetall. It was the largest self-propelled weapon to see service. Its heaviest munition was a 60mm (24 in) diameter, 2,170 kg (4,800 lb) shell, and the range for its lightest shell of 1,250 kg (2,800 lb) was just over 10 km (6.2 mi). Each gun had to be accompanied by a crane, a heavy transport trailer, and several modified tanks to carry shells.
new text: Thor is a Morser Karl, the largest self-propelled weapon of World War II, built by Rheinmetall. It fires 600mm shells of up to 2,170 kg, and its lightest shell reaches just over 10 km.

old text: The Royal Engineers are the most skilled engineers in the Commonwealth. Coming from Canada, they serve the Commonwealth with dedication, and come with all the tools necessary to create heavily fortified positions with hedgehogs, barbed wire, sandbags and mines. These engineers are the perfect choice to entrench a valuable position and thwart enemy attacks.
new text: 6 Canadian Royal Engineers with a Dodge, carrying the tools to build hedgehogs, barbed wire, sandbags and mines. Ideal for entrenching a valuable position against enemy attacks.

old text: This highly decorated division served longer in frontline combat than any other Australian division. It fought in campaigns in North Africa, Greece, and Syria before returning to fight the Japanese in New Guinea and Borneo.
new text: 12-man Australian squad from a highly decorated frontline division, with 2 MG teams, 4 SMGs including 2 Thompsons, an AT rifle, a rifle grenadier and a rifleman.

old text: A Universal Carrier with a Ronson flamethrower fitted. This vehicle is a perfect asset when you have too much of the enemy existing in one place and you want to change that situation.
new text: Universal Carrier with a Ronson flamethrower and a crew of 3. Ideal for burning out enemy troops massed in one place.

old text: The Cromwell Mk. VI is armed with a deadly 95mm howitzer designed for infantry support. The howitzer gun allows this vehicle to arch high explosive projectiles at targets while keeping the crew and the vehicle at safe combat distances. This variant retains the speed of its predecessor, but offers the firepower needed to destroy large emplacements and concentrated infantry.
new text: The Cromwell Mk. VI carries a 95mm howitzer that lobs HE at targets from a safe distance. It keeps the Cromwell's speed and destroys large emplacements and massed infantry.

old text: The Churchill AVRE is a Churchill Mk. VII variant mounted with a 290mm petard mortar. What it lacks in range, it makes up for in firepower. The incredible destructive force of the 290mm mortar can shred anything used for cover by the enemy, and even inflicts damage upon armored targets. Though it is well protected by the armor which the Churchill chassis provides, it nevertheless takes significant time to reload the mortar, so don't leave it in the line of fire unnecessarily!
new text: The Churchill AVRE is a Churchill Mk. VII with a short-range 290mm petard mortar that shreds cover and damages armor. Well armored but slow to reload; keep it out of the line of fire.

old text: The Churchill Crocodile is a Churchill Mk. VII variant which introduces a devastating flamethrower in place of the bow mounted hull machine-gun. With the Churchill's already substantial armor and 75mm gun, the addition of a flamethrower makes it perfectly suited for close-quarter and urban fighting. Torch enemy-occupied buildings to the ground, leaving no cover for escape -- but beware of enemy anti-tank assets, you don't want to lose this valuable unit to a hidden enemy!
new text: The Churchill Crocodile is a well-armored Churchill Mk. VII with a 75mm gun and a flamethrower in place of the hull MG, for close-quarter and urban fights. Beware hidden AT weapons.

old text: The Royal Artillery deploys a pair of 25pdr medium field howitzers under your command. Working in tandem, they can quickly inflict massive damage on your enemies, provided they have clear firing lines and visible targets. Unleashing their firepower on an unsuspecting enemy can quickly tear up enemy infantry formations and turn the tide of battle. Keep them out of the line of fire and they'll serve you well.
new text: Royal Artillery 25pdr medium field howitzer with an M3 and 4 crew. Tears up infantry given clear firing lines and visible targets; keep it out of the line of fire.

old text: The M4A4 Tulip is modified with rails attached to either side of the turret and designed to launch 3 inch rockets. The system is capable of firing two of these rockets and each containes a 60 pound warhead. This variant has the ability to produce devastating results and inflict horrendous causalities to our enemies!
new text: The M4A4 Tulip has rails on each side of the turret for two 3 inch rockets with 60 pound warheads. It can deal devastating damage and heavy casualties.

old text: The Saboteur is one of the finest commandos Britain can offer. He specializes in infiltration and sabotage, working behind enemy lines to subvert the enemy. This is the unit of choice to create havoc and eliminate key assets behind enemy lines. Go low and slow, use his additional stealth carefully and he will perform admirably for King and country.
new text: The Saboteur is a British commando who specializes in infiltration and sabotage behind enemy lines. Move low and slow and use his extra stealth to eliminate key enemy assets.

old text: The Canadian Black Watch are a veteran combat battalion used famously in the Battle of the Scheldt. This unit suffered horrondous combat losses, but distinguished itself as a fearsome fighting unit. The heroic and gallant men of the Canadian Black Watch are the perfect addition to any Commonwealth army.
new text: The Canadian Black Watch is a veteran combat battalion, famous for the Battle of the Scheldt where it suffered horrendous losses. A fearsome addition to any Commonwealth army.

old text: The Royal Commandos are the most experienced commando units of the Commonwealth. Arriving in a half-track, they possess the speed and mobility that will allow them to be the spearhead of your troops. By deploying the mines with which they are equipped, these chaps can prevent the enemy from re-taking their lost ground.
new text: The Royal Commandos are the Commonwealth's most experienced commandos, arriving in a half-track fast enough to spearhead an attack. Their mines stop the enemy retaking lost ground.

old text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman, capable of calling in precise artillery strikes with his signal flares. A trained artillery observer awaits in the rear, ready at a moments' notice to direct fire down onto any signals he sees. The Radio Operator's unique abilities make him valuable, and special care should be taken to keep him from harm.
new text: The Radio Operator calls in precise artillery strikes with signal flares, answered at once by a trained observer in the rear. He is valuable, so keep him out of harm's way.

old text: A MG42 Lafette HMG operated by two veteran vehicle opearators. These well experienced troops make up the backbone of German tactics.
new text: MG42 Lafette HMG with a crew of 2 veteran operators. Experienced troops like these are the backbone of German tactics.

old text: The Goliath or SdKfz 303 is a small, remote controlled tank that can carry up to 100kg of explosives. This masterpiece of German engineering is combined with a horrendous amount of explosives, making it one of the deadliest weapons in your arsenal! However, due to its weak protection, it's best when deployed in ambushes or cover.
new text: 3 Goliath SdKfz 303 remote-controlled tanks with 3 operators, each carrying up to 100kg of explosives. Deadly but weakly protected; use them from ambush or cover.

old text: The Volksgrenadier Sturm platoon contains 32 low-trained men of all types. Use this if you feel like using Soviet tactics or when Steiner wants to counter-attack.
new text: Volksgrenadier Sturm platoon of 32 low-trained men of all types, with StG44s, rifles, MGs and Panzerfausts. Suited to Soviet-style mass attacks and counter-attacks.

old text: The Marder III Ausf. M is a self-propelled anti-tank vehicle equipped with the 75mm PaK 40. Based on the Panzer 38(t) Ausf. H. chassis, these powerful tank destroyers are well armed, but thinly armored. A perfect tool to lure our enemies into an ambush worth our fatherland!
new text: The Marder III Ausf. M is a self-propelled 75mm PaK 40 on the Panzer 38(t) Ausf. H chassis, well armed but thinly armored. Ideal for luring enemies into an ambush.

old text: The StuH 42 is the most powerful unit available for breaking through enemy lines. The StuH 42 assault tank with a 105mm gun breaks through any obstacles and Panzergrenadiere provide supporting fire. Each soldier is armed with Panzerfausts or StG44, enabling them to deal with any and all armored targets they might encounter. These troops will leave nothing standing in the wake of their destruction!
new text: StuH 42 assault tank with a 105mm gun and a crew of 5. The most powerful unit for breaking through enemy lines and obstacles.

old text: The Pz IV. J Battle group is made up of two Panzerkampfwagen IV Ausf. J medium tanks.
new text: Pz IV battle group of two Panzerkampfwagen IV medium tanks with 10 crew.

old text: Two FlaK 18 artillery pieces.
new text: Two FlaK 18 artillery pieces towed by two SdKfz 8s, with 8 crew.

old text: The PaK 44 is an 128mm anti-tank gun developed to penetrate the heaviest of Allied tanks, including the American M26 Pershing, British Churchill Mk. VIII and the Soviet IS-2. A highly effective weapon, it is easily considered one of the best anti-tank weapons our superior German engineers have created so far!
new text: 128mm PaK 44 anti-tank gun with a SdKfz 8 and 4 crew. It penetrates the heaviest Allied tanks, including the M26 Pershing, Churchill Mk. VIII and IS-2.

old text: Two Sd.Kfz 251/1 halftracks each carrying a squad of Sturmpioneers supported by a pair of of Nebelwerfer 41s loaded with smoke rockets.
new text: Two Sd.Kfz 251/1 halftracks, each with an 8-man Sturmpioneer squad with a flamethrower and 2 MGs, plus two crewed Nebelwerfer 41s loaded with smoke rockets.

old text: The Veteran Tiger is a Tiger heavy tank with 230 range, manned by a battle-hardened crew. The crew of this vehicle are veterans of many battles and work together like a well-oiled machine. This is the best Germany has to offer. Strike fear into the very heart of our enemies with our most fearsome tank -- let nothing stand in your way!
new text: The Veteran Tiger is a Tiger heavy tank with 230 range and a battle-hardened crew of 5. The best Germany has to offer; let nothing stand in its way.

old text: The Veteran Panther is a 240 range PzKpfw Panther Ausf. G operated by very elite crew. These guys have read the Pantherfibel in ample detail, drawing careful attention to the naked girls inside. You can count on them to dispatch any armoured vehicle the enemy can throw at us. This vehicle makes our adversaries tremble and cry like little femboys -- as long as it frontally faces the enemy!
new text: The Veteran Panther is a PzKpfw Panther Ausf. G with 240 range and a veteran crew of 5. It can dispatch any enemy armor, as long as it faces the enemy frontally.

old text: The Sturmtiger is our most powerful assault gun. Equipped with a 380mm rocket mortar, it has the power to stop anything our enemy throws at us, and can eliminate even the strongest enemy fortifications. However, preparing the gun for fire is a lengthy process. Keep the Sturmtiger out of harm's way until it is ready to fire, and then unleash the full force of this powerful weapon!
new text: The Sturmtiger is an assault gun with a 380mm rocket mortar that destroys even the strongest fortifications. Readying the gun takes long; keep it out of harm's way until then.

old text: STRENG GEHEIM! This is a top-of-the-line heavy tank, the Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger Ausf. B 'Henschel turret', armed with a deadly 8mm KwK 43 crewed with the most experienced of all Wehrmacht tank crew. Annhilate the enemy armor in defense of the Vaterland!
new text: Top-secret Panzerkampfwagen VI Tiger Ausf. B 'Henschel turret' heavy tank with a deadly 8.8cm KwK 43 and the most experienced Wehrmacht crew. Built to annihilate enemy armor.

old text: The Panzerfaust Squad is equipped with a disposable preloaded tube capable of firing an anti-tank warhead. In the hands of our veterans, these recoilless weapons are highly effective against all types of armored vehicles and will stop our enemies dead in their tracks!
new text: The Panzerfaust Squad carries disposable preloaded anti-tank tubes. In veteran hands they are highly effective against all types of armored vehicles.

old text: The Brandenburger are an elite squad of the Wehrmacht and are adept at directly engaging enemies, but they are also taught how to operate behind the enemy front lines. They are tough and experienced, ready to prove themselves if used wisely. Use them strategically to find and exploit the enemies' weak spots.
new text: The Brandenburger are a tough, experienced elite Wehrmacht squad trained for direct combat and for operations behind enemy lines. Use them to find and exploit enemy weak spots.

old text: The Fallschirmjager are the most experienced paratrooper units that Germany has to offer. Arriving in a half-track, they possess the speed and mobility that fits them to be the spearhead of your troops. Equipped with the some of the best weapons available, they will fight to the bitter end, be it victory or death.
new text: The Fallschirmjager are Germany's most experienced paratroopers, arriving in a half-track to spearhead attacks. Armed with some of the best weapons available, they fight to the bitter end.

old text: The Radio Operator is a specially trained infantryman capable of calling in precise artillery strikes with his signal flares. A trained artillery observer awaits in the rear, ready at a moments' notice to direct fire down onto any signals he sees. The Radio Operator's unique abilities make him valuable, and special care should be taken to keep him from harm.
new text: The Radio Operator calls in precise artillery strikes with signal flares, answered at once by a trained observer in the rear. He is valuable, so keep him out of harm's way.

old text: An elite squad of tank hunters. Comes with two panzershreck operators and two panzershreck assistants, and works best when in concealment when an enemy tank comes too close.
new text: Elite tank hunter squad of 2 Panzerschreck operators and 2 assistants. Works best hidden, ambushing enemy tanks that come too close.

old text: A very large squad of 30 penal units armed with nothing but grenades, Karabiner 98ks, and MP40s, with some demo charges throughout. These troops are almost always meant to die, assaulting high-risk positions under the cover of more elite units.
new text: Very large squad of 30 penal troops with Karabiner 98ks, SMGs, grenades and a few demo charges. Expendable; they assault high-risk positions under cover of more elite units.

old text: This veteran field officer is capable of supporting your troops by spotting enemy units from afar with his binoculars. Use his skill in locating enemy units through the fog of war, so that your other units can engage or avoid them as necessary. The officer also reduces your current CP by 22 which allows you to field a bigger army, and comes with four jaegers armed with StG44s as his personal bodyguards when surveying the front.
new text: Veteran field officer group of 4 who spot enemy units through the fog of war with binoculars. Reduces current CP by 22, letting you field a bigger army.

old text: The radio operator is a valuable asset, allowing for the use of off-screen mortars to suppress a targeted area using his signal gun. He comes with six deployable flares in addition to an escort of two jaegers armed with MP40s.
new text: PzKpfw 38(t) Aufk vehicle with a crew of 4.

old text: 2 mechanized squads consisting of each a halftrack armed with a deadly 2.8cm SPzB 41 squeeze-bore gun and four jaegers that includes an MG42. These shock troops are dedicated to assaulting a position and neutralizing light vehicles along the way.
new text: Two SdKfz 250/11 halftracks with 2.8cm SPzB 41 squeeze-bore guns, carrying 12 jaegers with StG44s, G43s, SMGs, MG34s and Panzerfausts. Shock troops for assaults and light vehicles.

old text: The SdKfz/234 3 is an armored vehicle armed with the 75mm K 51 L/24 support gun. Armed with both HE and HEAT rounds, this vehicle works best at both supporting infantry advances and destroying light emplacements and fortifications.
new text: The SdKfz 234/3 is an armored vehicle with a 75mm K 51 L/24 support gun firing HE and HEAT. Best for supporting infantry advances and destroying light emplacements.

old text: The SdKfz 234/4 is an armored car equipped with the 7.5cm PaK 40 anti-tank cannon in addition to an auxiliary MG-34. Use this special vehicle to ambush valuable enemy assets before retreating to a new position.
new text: The SdKfz 234/4 is an armored car with a 7.5cm PaK 40 anti-tank cannon and an MG-34. Ambush valuable enemy assets with it, then retreat to a new position.

old text: This captured T-34-85 has been requisitioned by German forces for redeployment on the Eastern Front. Crewed by veteran tankmen, it also includes a complement of four jaegers as infantry support.
new text: Captured T-34-85 redeployed by German forces on the Eastern Front, with a crew of 4 and 4 jaegers as infantry support.

old text: This StuG III Ausf. G is crewed by elite tankmen; thanks to their veterancy, such a vehicle is perfect for quickly and effectively ambushing enemy vehicles from a longer range than what most normal StuG IIIs normally engage at.
new text: StuG III Ausf. G with an elite crew of 4. Ideal for quick ambushes of enemy vehicles from longer range than a normal StuG III.

old text: The Sturmpanzer IV is a heavy self-propelled gun armed with the 15cm StuH 43 L/12 cannon and staffed with an elite tank crew. With its high explosive shells, the Brummbar will be able to wreak havoc on the most fortified of positions and many heavy vehicles.
new text: The Sturmpanzer IV Brummbar is a heavy self-propelled gun with a 15cm StuH 43 L/12 and a crew of 4. Its HE shells wreck the most fortified positions and many heavy vehicles.

old text: The Schweres Wurfgerat 41 is a multiple rocket launcher that sends six devastating 28/32 cm high explosive or incendiary rockets at the enemy. It is a great weapon to harm both vehicles and fortifications, but must be kept guarded due to being deployed by infantry.
new text: Schweres Wurfgerat 41 rocket launcher with a SdKfz 8 and 4 crew, firing six 28/32cm HE or incendiary rockets. Hits vehicles and fortifications but needs guarding.

old text: The Jagdtiger is exactly what it name says. It's a tiger tank, for hunting down other tanks. The 128mm main gun makes this a beast of a tank killer. The frontal armor is almost impenetrable for most other tanks, but as with many tank destroyers, watch your tracks!
new text: The Jagdtiger is a Tiger built to hunt tanks, with a 128mm gun and frontal armor most tanks cannot penetrate. Like many tank destroyers, it must watch its tracks.

old text: The Veteran Sniper is a well-trained and highly skilled marksman. His deeds in service to the Fatherland are numerous and have earned him many awards. This long and distinguished service has made him a valued figure in the Wehrmacht and he now serves his country by passing on his knowledge to new soldiers. However, in urgent situations this highly experienced officer won't hesitate to serve his Fatherland on the front lines!
new text: The Veteran Sniper is a highly skilled, much-decorated marksman who now trains new soldiers. In urgent situations he still serves on the front line.

old text: A Sdfkz 251/1 filled with a squadron of veteran Panzergrenadiers from the 'Das Reich' division.
new text: A SdKfz 251/1 halftrack carrying an 11-man squad of veteran Panzergrenadiers from the 'Das Reich' division, with 2 MG teams and Panzerfausts.

old text: Two LeFH 18 105mm howitzers. Good for blowing stuff up, less good for getting blown up.
new text: Two LeFH 18 105mm howitzers towed by two SdKfz 8s, with 8 crew. Good for blowing stuff up, less good for getting blown up.

old text: The Tiger Ace is a PzKpfw Tiger Ausf. E with a ace crew.
new text: The Tiger Ace is a PzKpfw Tiger Ausf. E with an ace crew.

old text: Banzai chargers - 15-man melee-focused assault squad. Repeated-buy hero sequence enables sequential buys of individual squads for free. Inital - 1 squad, 15 min - 2 squads, 30 mins - 4 squads, 45 mins - 8 squads, 60 mins - 16 squads. Notably high stamina and strong sprint; best for shock assaults, point flooding, and tying down enemy lines.
new text: 15-man Banzai charger squad built for melee, with high stamina and a strong sprint, for shock assaults and flooding points. Later free buys: 2 squads at 15 min, 4 at 30, 8 at 45 and 16 at 60.

old text: Banzai chargers - 15-man melee-focused assault squad. Repeated-buy hero sequence enables sequential buys of individual squads for free. Inital - 1 squad, 15 min - 2 squads, 30 mins - 4 squads, 45 mins - 8 squads, 60 mins - 16 squads. Sequence-buy: 15 min cooldown tier.
new text: Free sequence buy of 15-man Banzai charger squads, unlocked at the 15 min tier. The sequence gives 1 squad at start, then 2 at 15 min, 4 at 30, 8 at 45 and 16 at 60.

old text: Banzai chargers - 15-man melee-focused assault squad. Repeated-buy hero sequence enables sequential buys of individual squads for free. Inital - 1 squad, 15 min - 2 squads, 30 mins - 4 squads, 45 mins - 8 squads, 60 mins - 16 squads. Sequence-buy: 30 min cooldown tier.
new text: Free sequence buy of 15-man Banzai charger squads, unlocked at the 30 min tier. The sequence gives 1 squad at start, then 2 at 15 min, 4 at 30, 8 at 45 and 16 at 60.

old text: Banzai chargers - 15-man melee-focused assault squad. Repeated-buy hero sequence enables sequential buys of individual squads for free. Inital - 1 squad, 15 min - 2 squads, 30 mins - 4 squads, 45 mins - 8 squads, 60 mins - 16 squads. Sequence-buy: 45 min cooldown tier.
new text: Free sequence buy of 15-man Banzai charger squads, unlocked at the 45 min tier. The sequence gives 1 squad at start, then 2 at 15 min, 4 at 30, 8 at 45 and 16 at 60.

old text: Banzai chargers - 15-man melee-focused assault squad. Repeated-buy hero sequence enables sequential buys of individual squads for free. Inital - 1 squad, 15 min - 2 squads, 30 mins - 4 squads, 45 mins - 8 squads, 60 mins - 16 squads. Sequence-buy: 60 min cooldown tier.
new text: Free sequence buy of 15-man Banzai charger squads, unlocked at the 60 min tier. The sequence gives 1 squad at start, then 2 at 15 min, 4 at 30, 8 at 45 and 16 at 60.

old text: This squad of 15 Konoe Shidan comes with 2 RPGs, 2 MGs, and 2 rifle grenadiers alongside 8 riflemen and SMG troops, all skill 5. They are perfectly trained to be a defensive fighting force, fortifying your lines while other units take on the offensive against the enemy.
new text: 15 Konoe Shidan guards with 2 RPGs, 3 MGs, rifle grenadiers, riflemen and SMG troops. A trained defensive force that holds your lines while other units attack.

old text: Chi-He hero tank with crew - balanced medium for general support. Engage mediums with positioning; avoid heavy AT lines.
new text: Five Chi-He medium tanks with crews, balanced for general support. Engage mediums with good positioning; avoid heavy AT lines.

old text: Elite 75mm Type 4 AA package with support vehicle. Strong AA coverage and credible AT; site as a static sector anchor.
new text: Two elite 75mm Type 4 AA guns with two support vehicles and 8 elite crew. Strong AA coverage and credible AT; site them as a static sector anchor.

old text: The Guards Snipers are our best snipers, trained to hunt down enemy sharpshooters and high ranking enemy officers. Working together, they can quickly eliminate enemy infantry from an area. They can be stealthy when needed, and can keep tabs on the enemy using their rifle scopes. Where possible, use them to take out important enemy targets such as officers, or weapon crews, allowing your forces to sweep in and overrun the enemy once they have been weakened!
new text: Two Guards Snipers with a GAZ-67, trained to hunt enemy sharpshooters, officers and weapon crews. Stealthy when needed; weaken key targets so your forces can overrun the enemy.

old text: A detachment of PTR anti tank riflemen. Two veterans armed with PTRS, a singular regular PTRD, and an assistant. 6 skill for the former. 3 skill for the two latter.
new text: 4-man PTR anti-tank rifle detachment with 2 veterans armed with PTRS rifles, a regular with a PTRD and an assistant.

old text: The Charge! attack is a attempt to overwhelm the enemy with sheer numeric force. Comrade -- these soldiers are laying down their lives for the Motherland, and there is no finer patriotic service than this!
new text: The Charge! attack is a 30-man wave of riflemen, SMG troops and MG teams that tries to overwhelm the enemy by sheer numbers.

old text: A recon section of light armor has been rushed forward at maximum speed to provide shock and awe on initial contact.
new text: Recon section of a T-60 and a T-70 light tank, rushed forward at top speed for shock and awe on first contact.

old text: The BS-3 is the heaviest anti-tank gun fielded by the Soviet Army. The 100mm gun penetrates even the toughest of armor and offers infantry excellent fire support. No longer will our foes dominate on the battlefield with their heavy machinery!
new text: BS-3 100mm anti-tank gun, the heaviest in the Soviet Army, with a T-34M and 4 crew. Penetrates the toughest armor and gives infantry excellent fire support.

old text: The Assault Troops are trained not to leave the tanks until they are under fire. Riding into battle on our OT-34 tanks, this force is well-equipped to deal with any threat. The accompanying infantry is trained to create a screen to defend the tanks from enemy infantry, while the tank takes on and eliminates any armored opposition. This well-rounded and diverse force will be able to turn back any attacker and seize victory for the Motherland!
new text: Two OT-34 flamethrower tanks carrying 8 assault troops with SMGs, who stay aboard until fired on. The infantry screens the tanks from enemy infantry while the tanks fight armor.

old text: The ISU-122 tank destroyers are powerfull units. While it is well-armored, it is the force of arms this vehicle possesses that teaches our enemies to quake at its approach: equipped with a 122mm cannon, this tank can destroy anything but the heaviest of enemy targets. Once the ISU-122 rolls onto the battlefield, retreat will be our enemies' only option!
new text: ISU-122 tank destroyer with a 122mm gun and a crew of 4, well armored and able to destroy all but the heaviest targets. Its approach leaves most enemies only retreat.

old text: The Stalin's Sledgehammers are two 203mm B-4M super-heavy howitzers. The 203mm B-4M howitzer showers massive destructive force upon your terrified enemies. This 203mm artillery piece is equipped to destroy just about any enemy unit, and can cause even the heaviest of enemy defenses to crumble. Designed to perform these tasks while maintaining a safe distance, it is important to keep this piece of artillery out of the line of fire. Clear a path for your tanks and troops, and lead the Soviet army to victory!
new text: The Stalin's Sledgehammers are two 203mm B-4M super-heavy howitzers with 5 crew, able to crush almost any unit and the heaviest defenses. Keep them safely out of the line of fire.

old text: A universal carrier APC supplied by the Commonwealth, we have armed it with a PTRS in place of the Bren
new text: Universal Carrier APC supplied by the Commonwealth, armed with a PTRS in place of the Bren.

old text: US logistics in full sprint to maximize material advantge; one heavy ammo crate, one infantry ammo crate, and one normal GMC Truck. You had horses, what were you thinking!
new text: US logistics group of a heavy ammo crate, an infantry ammo crate and a normal GMC truck with 6 men, rushed forward to maximize material advantage.

old text: A heavy rifle squad of 12 soldiers, composed of one bazooka, three rifle grenadiers, and two BAR teams. Having more rifle grenadiers, this squad is able to provide itself additional indirect firepower.
new text: Heavy 12-man rifle squad with a bazooka, 3 rifle grenadiers and 2 BAR teams. The extra rifle grenadiers give it its own indirect firepower.

old text: Two 3 man teams of elite marines with M2 Carbines equipped with M1 Sniper Scope night fighter attachment, dubbed under code word 'M2 with T3 Mounting'. This scope allows for high degree of accuracy but limited to only 60m range. The equipment is also rather heavy. Skill 6 except SL and SA at 7 skill
new text: Three 3-man night fighter teams of elite marines with M2 Carbines fitted with the M1 Sniper Scope ('M2 with T3 Mounting'). Very accurate but limited to 60m, and the kit is heavy.

old text: The M8 Howitzer is a 75mm light howitzer that enables us to bolster the firepower of our airborne forces. This gun is best used behind cover, where it can take advantage of its arched trajectory. Although not the most accurate weapon, it is still capable of destroying light vehicles and field fortifications. Use it to your advantage and it will serve you well.
new text: M8 75mm light howitzer dropped with 2 airborne crew to back up airborne forces. Fires arched shots from cover; not very accurate, but it destroys light vehicles and field fortifications.

old text: An air dropped M1_57mm AT gun with two veteran partroopers to arm it.
new text: Air-dropped M1 57mm AT gun with two veteran paratroopers to crew it.

old text: The M4A3R2 Croc takes the regular chassis of our M4A3 Sherman, but replaces the coaxial machine gun with a devastating flamethrower. This enables the Croc to ferret out enemy troops and torch any cover that might potentially be use to conceal them. However, it lacks any improvements in armor, so care must be taken to ensure that it does not fall victim to the enemy. Make use of its speed to keep it out of enemy sights.
new text: The M4A3R2 Croc is an M4A3 Sherman with a flamethrower in place of the coaxial MG, made to burn enemy troops out of cover. It has no extra armor, so use its speed to stay unseen.

old text: An elite mechanized detachment with two LVT4-A armed with 75mm howitzers and multiple machine guns each of these have a squad of elite marine raiders. Skill 5 except for the SL and SA at 6 skill
new text: Elite mechanized detachment of two LVT4-As with 75mm howitzers and several MGs, each carrying a squad of 12 elite marine raiders.

old text: The Mass Production of vehicles allows us to outnumber our enemies. While our tanks may not equal the armor and firepower of our enemies', we nevertheless make up for this technological gap by sheer power in number, which they can't hope to match. These two Sherman 76's will help you outmanoeuvre the enemy and allow you to deliver a crippling blow. Forward thrust -- let's drive them from the battlefield with our strength in numbers!
new text: Five Shermans, three M4A3 (75) and two M4A3E8 (76), that make up in numbers what they lack in armor and firepower. Use them to outmanoeuvre the enemy and strike a crippling blow.

old text: The M4A3E8(76)W Fury is manned by an elite crew, giving it increased rate of fire, better overall mobility and carries a few special rounds of ammunition.
new text: The M4A3E8(76)W Fury has an elite crew, giving it a higher rate of fire and better mobility, and carries a few special rounds.

old text: The M4A3E2(76)W Jumbo is a field modification of the regular Jumbo variant. While retaining the superb armor of the Jumbo, the 75mm M3 gun has been upgraded to the 76mm high-velocity gun. This allows the Jumbo 76 to effectively engage and destroy even the heaviest of enemy armored vehicles, while being afforded a high level of protection by the Jumbo's thick armor. Some speed is sacrificed with this combination, but it can easily turn the tide of battle when used properly.
new text: M4A3E2(76)W Jumbo, a field-modified Jumbo with a 76mm high-velocity gun and superb armor, plus three Willys jeeps. It gives up some speed but can destroy even the heaviest enemy armor.

old text: The Super Pershing is an up-gunned and up-armored variant of our M26 Pershing heavy tank. It is equipped with a long-barrelled 90mm M3 gun, which boasts armor penetration capabilities far superior to that of any other weapon in our arsenal. Fitted with additional armor plating, this tank can tackle even the heaviest of enemy vehicles. This critical piece of equipment may be just what you need to snatch victory from the jaws of defeat!
new text: The Super Pershing is an M26 Pershing with a long 90mm M3 gun and extra armor plates, out-penetrating every other US gun. It can tackle even the heaviest enemy vehicles.

old text: One 155mm GMC M12 artillery tank. These battle-hardened artillery crew can provide precise and fast fire support to any location you desire. They are loyal to you and will strike the enemy accurately as long as you provide them with ample amounts of ammo.
new text: One 155mm GMC M12 artillery tank with a crew of 3, giving precise and fast fire support anywhere as long as it has ample ammo.

old text: Brixia 45mm light mortar - rapid light HE/smoke for close support and screening. Use to cover assaults, not to destroy fortifications. Resupply: Infantry ammo crate.
new text: Brixia 45mm light mortar with 2 crew, firing rapid light HE and smoke for close support and screening. Covers assaults but cannot break fortifications; resupply from an infantry ammo crate.

old text: Brixia 45mm light mortar - rapid light HE/smoke for close support and screening. Use to cover assaults, not to destroy fortifications. Resupply: Infantry ammo crate. Sequence-buy: two mortars.
new text: Brixia 45mm light mortar with 2 crew, firing rapid light HE and smoke for close support and screening. Sequence-buy x2 card with one mortar; resupply from an infantry ammo crate.

old text: Brixia 45mm light mortar - rapid light HE/smoke for close support and screening. Use to cover assaults, not to destroy fortifications. Resupply: Infantry ammo crate. Sequence-buy: three mortars.
new text: Brixia 45mm light mortar with 2 crew, firing rapid light HE and smoke for close support and screening. Sequence-buy x3 card with one mortar; resupply from an infantry ammo crate.

old text: 75mm Resita AT gun - high penetration for medium/heavy armor. Strong static anchor; conceal, fire, and shift positions. Sequence-buy: two guns.
new text: Two 75mm Resita AT guns with 4 crew and high penetration against medium and heavy armor. Strong static anchors; conceal, fire and shift positions.

old text: M11/39 light tank - 37mm hull gun with limited turret MG. Fire support for infantry; favor flanking due to restricted turret armament. Sequence-buy: two tanks.
new text: M11/39 light tank with a 37mm hull gun and a turret MG, sold as a sequence-buy x2 card with one tank. Gives infantry fire support; favor flanking due to its limited turret armament.

old text: M5/18 light tank - short-barrel 75mm for strong HE support; limited AT. Pair with dedicated AT assets. Sequence-buy: two tanks.
new text: M5/18 light tank with a short-barrel 75mm for strong HE support but limited AT, sold as a sequence-buy x2 card with one tank. Pair it with dedicated AT assets.

old text: Bersaglieri motorcycle fireteam for rapid reconnaissance and swift point holds. Includes SA 500 motorcycle with a rifleman, two SMG troopers, and an LMG gunner with assistant. Employ hit-and-run tactics.
new text: Bersaglieri motorcycle group of 11 men on 7 Guzzi SA 500 motorcycles, with rifles, SMGs and an LMG team. Built for rapid reconnaissance, swift point holds and hit-and-run tactics.

old text: A mechanized version of the Sturmgrenadier assault squad. 8 sturmgrenadiers deploy from a SdKfz 251/1 halftrack which contains an MG42 and MG34 in addition to extra infantry supplies.
new text: Mechanized Sturmgrenadier assault squad of 8 in a SdKfz 251/1 halftrack that carries an MG42, an MG34 and extra infantry supplies.

old text: A mechanized version of the Panzergrenadier squad. 7 panzergrenadiers deploy from a SdKfz 251/1 halftrack which contains an MG42 and MG34 in addition to extra infantry supplies.
new text: Mechanized Panzergrenadier squad of 9 in a SdKfz 251/1 halftrack that carries an MG42, an MG34 and extra infantry supplies.

old text: The Fallschirmjager squad is a elite trained squad with 2 MG42s, 3 k98 rifles, 1 STG44, 1 k98 sniper rifle, 2 FG42s and 1 MP40. The squad has 10 men total. Includes 2 Panzerfausts. Soldiers are skill 7. Comes with parachutes and a sense of hope.
new text: Elite 10-man Fallschirmjager squad dropped by parachute, with 2 MG42s, 2 FG42s, 3 K98s, a K98 sniper rifle, an StG44, an MP40 and 2 Panzerfausts.

old text: 81mm mortar team for indirect fire (HE/smoke/WP/illum). Screens pushes and breaks entrenched infantry; vulnerable if exposed. Resupply: Infantry ammo crate.
new text: 81mm mortar team for indirect fire with HE, smoke, WP and illumination rounds, resupplied from an infantry ammo crate. Screens pushes and breaks entrenched infantry; vulnerable if exposed.

old text: 120mm heavy mortar with long reach (HE/smoke/WP/illum). Anchor for area denial and suppression; protect from counter-fire. Resupply: Heavy ammo crate (Artillery).
new text: 120mm heavy mortar with long reach for HE, smoke, WP and illumination fire, resupplied from a heavy artillery ammo crate. Anchors area denial and suppression; protect it from counter-fire.

old text: A mechanized squad consisting of four jaegers armed with 2 MAB 38 submachine guns, a scoped StG44, and a G43, alongside a SdKfz 250/1 halftrack armed with one MG42. These troops are dedicated towards rapid deployment and securement of a target, or to quickly break through a weak point in the enemy line.
new text: Mechanized squad of 6 jaegers with MAB 38 SMGs, a scoped StG44 and G43 rifles in a SdKfz 250/1 halftrack with an MG42. Built to seize a target fast or break through a weak point.

old text: Ha-Go light tank - fast scout and infantry support. Strong vs soft targets; avoid direct fights with mediums. Sequence-buy: two tanks.
new text: Two Ha-Go light tanks with crews, fast scouts and infantry support. Strong against soft targets; avoid direct fights with mediums.

old text: The Mechanised armoured rifle squad is a 10-man squad armed with 8 M1 Garands, 1 B.A.R and one M1 Garand with M7 Grenade launcher which arrive in a M3A1 half-track. The half-track has a Bazooka. Soldiers are skill 3 except the SL which is skill 4.
new text: Mechanised 10-man armoured rifle squad with 8 M1 Garands, a B.A.R and an M1 Garand with M7 grenade launcher, arriving in an M3A1 half-track that carries a Bazooka.

old text: The Airborne squad is a 12-man squad armed with 4 M1 Garands, 3 M1A1 Carbines, 1 B.A.R, 1 .30 cal M1919 A6, 1 M1903A4 sniper, one M1 Garand with M7 Grenade launcher and a Thompson. Soldiers are skill 5 except the SL which is skill 6. Comes with parachutes and a sense of hope.
new text: 12-man Airborne squad dropped by parachute, with 4 M1 Garands, 3 M1A1 Carbines, a B.A.R, a .30 cal M1919 A6, an M1903A4 sniper, an M1 Garand with M7 grenade launcher and a Thompson.

old text: The 101st Airborne squad is a 12-man squad armed with 4 M1 Garands, 2 M1A1 Carbines, 1 B.A.R, 1 .30 cal M1919 A6, 1 M1903A4 sniper, 1 M9A1 Bazooka, one M1 Garand with M7 Grenade launcher and a Thompson. Soldiers are skill 7. Comes with parachutes and a sense of hope.
new text: 12-man 101st Airborne squad dropped by parachute, with 4 M1 Garands, 2 M1A1 Carbines, a B.A.R, a .30 cal M1919 A6, an M1903A4 sniper, an M9A1 Bazooka, an M1 Garand with M7 launcher and a Thompson.

old text: The Paramarine squad is a 12-man squad armed with 4 M1 Garands, 3 M1941 Johnson Rifles, 2 M50 Reisings, 2 M1941 Johnson LMGs and one M1 Garand with M7 Grenade launcher. Soldiers are skill 6. Comes with parachutes and a sense of hope.
new text: 11-man Paramarine squad dropped by parachute, with M1 Garands, M1941 Johnson Rifles, M50 Reisings, 2 M1941 Johnson LMGs and an M1 Garand with M7 grenade launcher.

old text: Supply trucks carrying fuel canisters, repair kits, ammunition, grenades and other equipment.\n The Opel Blitz was a reliable and easy to maintain vehicle present in all theatres of WWII. It was ideally suited for harsh battlefield conditions and was used in different versions, from ambulance trucks to mobile HQs. The Blitz is perfect for transporting troops and towing artillery.
new text: A supply truck carrying fuel canisters, repair kits, ammunition, grenades and other equipment. Reliable and easy to maintain, it can also carry troops and tow artillery.

old text: The 40M Csaba was an armoured scout car produced for the Royal Hungarian Army during World War II. The Csaba had a 8 mm machine gun fixed on a centrally mounted turret, with 9 mm armoured plating. The vehicle was also equipped with a detachable 8 mm light machine gun fired through the rear hatch in the anti-aircraft role. The crew could dismount and carry this MG when conducting reconnaissance on foot. It also had two driving positions - one at the front as normal, and an additional one at the rear.
new text: The 40M Csaba is a Hungarian armoured scout car with an 8 mm turret machine gun and 9 mm armour plating. Its crew can dismount a second 8 mm MG to scout on foot.

old text: The 39M Csaba was an armoured scout car produced for the Royal Hungarian Army during World War II. The Csaba had a 20 mm cannon and an 8 mm machine gun fixed on a centrally mounted turret, with 9 mm armoured plating. The vehicle was also equipped with a detachable 8 mm light machine gun fired through the rear hatch in the anti-aircraft role. The crew could dismount and carry this MG when conducting reconnaissance on foot. It also had two driving positions - one at the front as normal, and an additional one at the rear.
new text: The 39M Csaba is a Hungarian armoured scout car with a 20 mm cannon and an 8 mm machine gun in the turret and 9 mm armour plating. Its crew can dismount a second 8 mm MG to scout on foot.

old text: The 40M Nimrod was a World War II Hungarian anti-aircraft tank based on a license built copy of the Swedish Luftvarnskanonvagn L-62 Anti II tank. Originally, it was intended to be used as an anti-aircraft and anti-tank weapon, but it proved to be ineffective against Soviet T-34 tanks. Therefore, it was primarily utilized against lightly armored vehicles and for air defense.
new text: The 40M Nimrod is a Hungarian anti-aircraft tank based on the Swedish L-62 Anti II. Ineffective against the T-34, it is best used against aircraft and lightly armored vehicles.

old text: Toldi tanks entered Hungarian service in 1940. They first saw action with the Hungarian Army against Yugoslavia in 1941.These tanks were mostly used against the USSR between 1941-1944. Because of their light armour, armament and good communications equipment, they were mostly used for reconnaissance. The design was no match against Soviet T-34 medium tanks encountered during the early stages of Operation Barbarossa.
new text: The Toldi is a Hungarian light tank with light armour and armament and good communications equipment, mostly used for reconnaissance. It is no match for Soviet T-34 medium tanks.

old text: Toldi tanks entered Hungarian service in 1940. They first saw action with the Hungarian Army against Yugoslavia in 1941.These tanks were mostly used against the USSR between 1941-1944. Because of their light armour, armament and good communications equipment, they were mostly used for reconnaissance. The design was no match against Soviet T-34 medium tanks encountered during the early stages of Operation Barbarossa.
new text: The Toldi is a Hungarian light tank with light armour and armament and good communications equipment, mostly used for reconnaissance. It is no match for Soviet T-34 medium tanks.

old text: Following the success of assault guns on the World War II Eastern Front, the Hungarians developed their own model, based on the chassis of the Turan tank. There were two designs, the 44M Zrinyi I, incorporated a long 43M 75mm gun, but it did not pass the prototype stage. The 40/43M Zrinyi II was armed with a 40M 105mm L/20 howitzer.The Zrinyi II design was a traditional infantry support vehicle. The Zrinyi I was hoped to fulfill an anti-tank role.Between 40 and 66 Zrinyi II units were produced between August 1943 and July 1944 and a single Zrinyi I prototype. There is only one surviving Zrinyi II in the Kubinka tank museum near Moscow.
new text: The 40/43M Zrinyi II is a Hungarian assault gun on the Turan chassis, armed with a 40M 105mm L/20 howitzer. It is a traditional infantry support vehicle.

old text: The Turan was produced in several versions. The Turan I was the original medium tank type, which mounted the 40 mm gun. The gun, the standard Hungarian light anti-tank gun, could fire the same ammunition as the Bofors 40 mm anti-aircraft gun. The gun was mounted in a riveted turret. A total of 285 tanks were produced between 1941 and 1944.After the disastrous Stalingrad offensive, the army realized that they needed a more powerful weapon to counter the more effective Soviet tanks, especially the T-34. A variant was ordered which utilized a short 75 mm gun in an enlarged turret. Known as the 41M Turan II, this vehicle otherwise remained virtually unchanged from the original vehicle.
new text: The Turan I is a Hungarian medium tank with a 40 mm gun in a riveted turret, firing the same ammunition as the Bofors 40 mm. It is outclassed by Soviet tanks such as the T-34.

old text: The Turan was produced in several versions. The Turan I was the original medium tank type, which mounted the 40 mm gun. The gun, the standard Hungarian light anti-tank gun, could fire the same ammunition as the Bofors 40 mm anti-aircraft gun. The gun was mounted in a riveted turret. A total of 285 tanks were produced between 1941 and 1944.After the disastrous Stalingrad offensive, the army realized that they needed a more powerful weapon to counter the more effective Soviet tanks, especially the T-34. A variant was ordered which utilized a short 75 mm gun in an enlarged turret. Known as the 41M Turan II, this vehicle otherwise remained virtually unchanged from the original vehicle.
new text: The 41M Turan II is a Hungarian medium tank with a short 75 mm gun in an enlarged turret, built to counter Soviet tanks such as the T-34.

old text: The Turan was produced in several versions. The Turan I was the original medium tank type, which mounted the 40 mm gun. The gun, the standard Hungarian light anti-tank gun, could fire the same ammunition as the Bofors 40 mm anti-aircraft gun. The gun was mounted in a riveted turret. A total of 285 tanks were produced between 1941 and 1944.After the disastrous Stalingrad offensive, the army realized that they needed a more powerful weapon to counter the more effective Soviet tanks, especially the T-34. A variant was ordered which utilized a short 75 mm gun in an enlarged turret. Known as the 41M Turan II, this vehicle otherwise remained virtually unchanged from the original vehicle.The Turan III was the last model equipped with a German 75 mm long gun with high muzzle velocity, the 75 mm KwK L/43. This project never exceeded the stage of prototype.
new text: The Turan III is the last Turan medium tank model, a prototype armed with a long, high-velocity German 75 mm KwK L/43 gun.
